hooks.text: A wealthy Texas school chose free waste gas to save money.
Nearly three hundred students died when an odorless gas leak destroyed their school.
An electric sander ignited gas pooled beneath a wealthy Texas school in 1937.

title: Why Did a Wealthy Texas School Use Free Waste Gas? ⚠️
description: On March 18, 1937, a massive natural gas explosion destroyed the New London School in Texas, killing nearly 300 students and teachers and changing safety laws forever.
